ai_summary: Almondz Global Securities Ltd. is undertaking a demerger of its Infrastructure Advisory Business into a new, independent entity, Almondz Global Infra-Consultant Limited, effective from FY 2025-26. This demerged segment represents a relatively small portion, 4.58%, of the company's total turnover. The strategic rationale aims to create focused business entities for better resource allocation, attract specialized investors, and potentially unlock value by separating the distinct infrastructure advisory operations from the core stockbroking business, pending numerous regulatory and shareholder approvals.
